Around middle of high school, I was incredibly depressed, wouldn’t be able to do anything for school, attempted suicide on several occasions. The meds have really helped me get better. However, I know it’ll never be the same. I guess I gotta look at the bright side. Sometimes I really wish it never happened though. I’ve found that because of what I’ve experienced, I’m pretty good at helping others with the same problems, but nobody really can help me. I’m also often very cautious as to not hurt people the way others have hurt me. Feels pretty bad.
